capabilities: automatically sync highlights from supported reading services into the vault
customize export format with Jinja2 templates
enrich exports with metadata like cover images, URLs, authors and tags
extras: Requires a paid Readwise subscription, which the README states explicitly; all syncing goes through the Readwise service.
problem: Highlights made in outside reading apps and e-book platforms stay in those services and require manual copying to become usable notes in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Connect the plugin to your Readwise account

summary: Official Readwise plugin that automatically syncs reading highlights from Kindle, Pocket, Instapaper and other services into vault notes.
